mapper.select: SELECT sc.id, sc.student_id, sc.class_id, sc.course_id, sc.exam_name, sc.exam_type, sc.score, sc.exam_date, sc.create_time, sc.update_time, sc.is_deleted, s.student_no, s.name AS student_name, s.gender, cl.class_name, co.course_name, co.full_score FROM score sc LEFT JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN `class` cl ON sc.class_id = cl.id AND cl.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course co ON sc.course_id = co.id AND co.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sc.id = #{id} AND sc.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score (student_id, class_id, course_id, exam_name, exam_type, score, exam_date, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{classId}, #{courseId}, #{examName}, #{examType}, #{score}, #{examDate}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE score SET score = #{score}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO score (student_id, class_id, course_id, exam_name, exam_type, score, exam_date, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES
(#{item.studentId}, #{item.classId}, #{item.courseId}, #{item.examName}, #{item.examType}, #{item.score}, #{item.examDate}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(sc.score) AS scored_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS absent_count, CAST(COALESCE(MAX(sc.score), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS max_score, CAST(COALESCE(MIN(sc.score), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS min_score, CAST(COALESCE(AVG(sc.score), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS avg_score, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score IS NOT NULL AND sc.score >= co.full_score * 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pass_count FROM score sc JOIN course co ON sc.course_id = co.id AND co.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sc.class_id = #{classId} AND sc.course_id = #{courseId} AND sc.exam_name = #{examName} AND sc.is_deleted = 0
